quote: If the driver of a vehicle intends to turn at an intersection and: The turn is a right turn, both the approach for the right turn and the right turn must be made from the right turn lane if the highway has a right turn lane as set forth in subsection 4 of NRS 484B.223 [NRS-484B-223-4a, NRS-484B-223-4b], or must be made from the extreme right lane.

activation.condition: driver intends a right turn at an intersection

obligation.description: make both the right-turn approach and turn from the right-turn lane when present, otherwise from the extreme right lane

timing.description: during the approach and right turn

judgment_calls_needed.note: Interior intent is not directly observable; preserve authored command and observed turn separately.

parameter_refs.name: commanded_approach_lane_y_m
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: rightmost and inner approach lane centers, measured separately

parameter_refs.name: actual_right_turn_lane_occupancy
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: measured Native full-body approach lane occupancy, initially unknown
